rationale: The ToRef trait (in contrib::exec_spec) already specifies ensures res.deep_view() == self.deep_view(). Adding the same postcondition on this impl is therefore redundant and triggers the already_specified_via_trait checker complaint and compilation errors. No stronger, non‑redundant postcondition is expressible with the current vstd vocabulary for this impl.
risks: If the trait-level spec is later weakened or removed, revisiting this impl to add an explicit postcondition may be necessary.
The harness/compilation errors shown (missing imports, private module) are unrelated to the semantic intent of the postcondition and must be fixed separately if present.
